summary: HTTP requests intermittently return 503 during traffic bursts
issue_description: HTTP requests intermittently return 503 during traffic bursts. Operational logs and application-server diagnostics confirmed the behavior.
root_cause: The servlet executor reached its configured concurrency ceiling and queued requests exceeded the container timeout.
solution: Tune executor capacity using load-test data, configure bounded queues, and alert on thread saturation.

summary: A scheduled reconciliation task starts several minutes late
issue_description: A scheduled reconciliation task starts several minutes late. The issue was reproduced under representative workload and isolated to the application-server integration layer.
root_cause: The timer scheduler was configured with an incorrect misfire threshold after a server restart.
solution: Set an appropriate misfire policy, persist scheduler state, and monitor trigger delay.

summary: Concurrent updates produce optimistic locking failures for valid users
issue_description: Concurrent updates produce optimistic locking failures for valid users. Operational logs and application-server diagnostics confirmed the behavior.
root_cause: Two transactions update the same entity version concurrently without an application conflict strategy.
solution: Catch OptimisticLockException, reload the entity, and apply a bounded retry or user-visible conflict response.

summary: Message processing stops after the broker reports temporary unavailability
issue_description: Message processing stops after the broker reports temporary unavailability. The issue was reproduced under representative workload and isolated to the application-server integration layer.
root_cause: The JMS connection recovery policy does not recreate consumers after broker reconnection.
solution: Enable managed reconnection, recreate consumers safely, and monitor consumer registration state.

summary: Application starts but an integration lookup fails only in staging
issue_description: Application starts but an integration lookup fails only in staging. Operational logs and application-server diagnostics confirmed the behavior.
root_cause: The staging JNDI binding uses a different resource name from the application deployment descriptor.
solution: Align JNDI names, externalize environment bindings, and validate mandatory resources during startup.

summary: Long-running business operation fails at commit time
issue_description: Long-running business operation fails at commit time. The issue was reproduced under representative workload and isolated to the application-server integration layer.
root_cause: The transaction exceeded the application server transaction timeout while waiting on a downstream operation.
solution: Remove remote calls from the transaction, split the workflow into smaller transactions, and tune timeouts from measured workload.

summary: REST endpoint returns 500 instead of a documented validation error
issue_description: REST endpoint returns 500 instead of a documented validation error. Operational logs and application-server diagnostics confirmed the behavior.
root_cause: A Bean Validation exception is not mapped by the shared JAX-RS exception mapper.
solution: Add a validation exception mapper returning the standard 400 response and contract-test invalid requests.

summary: SOAP integration fails when partner response contains a new optional element
issue_description: SOAP integration fails when partner response contains a new optional element. The issue was reproduced under representative workload and isolated to the application-server integration layer.
root_cause: Generated JAXB classes were created from an older partner WSDL and reject the newer schema shape.
solution: Regenerate bindings from the supported WSDL, validate compatibility, and retain representative partner payload tests.

summary: Application becomes slow while database CPU is normal
issue_description: Application becomes slow while database CPU is normal. Operational logs and application-server diagnostics confirmed the behavior.
root_cause: Most requests are waiting for JDBC connections because pool size is below measured concurrent demand.
solution: Right-size the pool, configure acquisition timeouts, and monitor active, idle, and waiting connections.

summary: Application node repeatedly restarts after sustained traffic
issue_description: Application node repeatedly restarts after sustained traffic. The issue was reproduced under representative workload and isolated to the application-server integration layer.
root_cause: Heap occupancy remains high because a request-scoped object graph is retained by a static collection.
solution: Remove the static retention path, verify object lifecycle, and use heap analysis in regression testing.

summary: One administrative page renders stale configuration text
issue_description: One administrative page renders stale configuration text. Operational logs and application-server diagnostics confirmed the behavior.
root_cause: The JSP generated artifact was not invalidated on one cluster member after deployment.
solution: Clear generated JSP artifacts during rollout and make deployment behavior identical across nodes.

summary: Application startup fails with an ambiguous dependency error
issue_description: Application startup fails with an ambiguous dependency error. The issue was reproduced under representative workload and isolated to the application-server integration layer.
root_cause: Two CDI beans expose the same interface without a qualifier and the injection point is ambiguous.
solution: Add explicit qualifiers, remove unused implementations, and add deployment-time CDI validation.

summary: Protected endpoint is accessible without the expected role
issue_description: Protected endpoint is accessible without the expected role. Operational logs and application-server diagnostics confirmed the behavior.
root_cause: A URL pattern in web.xml does not match the deployed context path and bypasses the intended constraint.
solution: Correct security-constraint URL mappings and add automated authorization tests for every protected endpoint.

summary: Scheduled report runs twice after application failover
issue_description: Scheduled report runs twice after application failover. The issue was reproduced under representative workload and isolated to the application-server integration layer.
root_cause: Both cluster nodes believe they own the scheduler because clustered job-store configuration is incomplete.
solution: Use a shared clustered job store, enable scheduler clustering, and verify single execution during failover tests.

summary: Users see outdated account settings for several minutes
issue_description: Users see outdated account settings for several minutes. Operational logs and application-server diagnostics confirmed the behavior.
root_cause: Application cache TTL is longer than the business requirement and update operations do not evict affected keys.
solution: Invalidate keys on successful updates and reduce TTL to the agreed consistency window.

summary: Partner API calls fail after periods of inactivity
issue_description: Partner API calls fail after periods of inactivity. The issue was reproduced under representative workload and isolated to the application-server integration layer.
root_cause: Pooled HTTP connections remain idle beyond the partner load balancer timeout and are reused after closure.
solution: Evict idle connections before the partner timeout and configure connection validation.

summary: Cluster deployment can leave nodes on different application versions
issue_description: Cluster deployment can leave nodes on different application versions. Operational logs and application-server diagnostics confirmed the behavior.
root_cause: Deployment verification checks node health but not deployed artifact identity.
solution: Record application build version and checksum on each node and fail rollout if versions differ.

summary: Operational logs cannot correlate a user request across EJB and JMS processing
issue_description: Operational logs cannot correlate a user request across EJB and JMS processing. The issue was reproduced under representative workload and isolated to the application-server integration layer.
root_cause: Correlation ID exists at the HTTP layer but is not copied into asynchronous message metadata.
solution: Propagate a non-sensitive correlation ID in JMS message properties and include it in MDC logging context.

summary: Large nightly import stops after processing part of the file
issue_description: Large nightly import stops after processing part of the file. Operational logs and application-server diagnostics confirmed the behavior.
root_cause: The batch job keeps the entire file and all managed JPA entities in memory until completion.
solution: Process chunks, flush and clear the persistence context, and persist checkpoints for restart.

summary: Certificate expiration is discovered only when an integration fails
issue_description: Certificate expiration is discovered only when an integration fails. The issue was reproduced under representative workload and isolated to the application-server integration layer.
root_cause: JVM truststore certificates are not inventoried by the monitoring platform.
solution: Export certificate expiry metadata and alert before configurable warning thresholds.

summary: API response contains inconsistent timestamps after a rolling restart
issue_description: API response contains inconsistent timestamps after a rolling restart. The behavior was reproduced in the production environment using representative J2EE workload and application-server diagnostics.
root_cause: Timestamp conversion occurs in more than one layer and uses different timezone assumptions. The deployment sequence left stale runtime metadata on one node.
solution: Persist UTC and perform timezone conversion only at the presentation boundary. Clear runtime metadata, restart the affected subsystem, and add post-deployment smoke tests.

summary: Application startup is unexpectedly slow during peak concurrency
issue_description: Application startup is unexpectedly slow during peak concurrency. The behavior was reproduced in the qa environment using representative J2EE workload and application-server diagnostics.
root_cause: Component scanning or classpath discovery includes unnecessary packages. A container resource limit was lower than the measured production concurrency.
solution: Narrow scanning scope and remove unused libraries from the deployment archive. Tune the resource limit from load-test evidence and add saturation alerts.

summary: Error response loses the original business error code after a configuration change
issue_description: Error response loses the original business error code after a configuration change. The behavior was reproduced in the development environment using representative J2EE workload and application-server diagnostics.
root_cause: A generic exception handler replaces the domain error with a server error. An environment override was not propagated to all cluster members.
solution: Preserve stable business error codes through the exception-mapping layer. Centralize the configuration source and validate effective configuration on every node.

summary: Repeated retries create duplicate business events when a downstream service is slow
issue_description: Repeated retries create duplicate business events when a downstream service is slow. The behavior was reproduced in the production environment using representative J2EE workload and application-server diagnostics.
root_cause: The processing operation has no idempotency key or uniqueness constraint. The synchronous integration call has no bounded timeout.
solution: Add an idempotency key, enforce uniqueness in the database, and make retries safe. Add connect/read/overall timeouts and a controlled fallback or circuit breaker.

summary: Metrics show healthy service while users receive failures after database maintenance
issue_description: Metrics show healthy service while users receive failures after database maintenance. The behavior was reproduced in the staging environment using representative J2EE workload and application-server diagnostics.
root_cause: Health check tests only the JVM process and not required application resources. The application reused pooled connections that were invalidated by the database.
solution: Separate liveness from readiness and verify critical datasource/JMS dependencies in readiness. Enable connection validation and stale-connection eviction.

summary: Database query latency increases after a release with unusually large requests
issue_description: Database query latency increases after a release with unusually large requests. The behavior was reproduced in the qa environment using representative J2EE workload and application-server diagnostics.
root_cause: A new ORM query path prevents the database from using the expected index. The request path materializes the complete payload before validation and processing.
solution: Review execution plans, add or adjust indexes, and include query-plan regression checks. Enforce request-size limits and stream or chunk large payloads.

summary: Application logs contain duplicate entries after failover
issue_description: Application logs contain duplicate entries after failover. The behavior was reproduced in the development environment using representative J2EE workload and application-server diagnostics.
root_cause: Logging is configured both at the application and container root logger. Cluster ownership state was not persisted consistently between nodes.
solution: Disable duplicate propagation and standardize logger hierarchy. Use shared durable cluster state and test failover/failback scenarios.

summary: User preferences revert after refresh when an exception occurs
issue_description: User preferences revert after refresh when an exception occurs. The behavior was reproduced in the production environment using representative J2EE workload and application-server diagnostics.
root_cause: A background synchronization process writes an older snapshot over the current record. A cleanup path is skipped when an unchecked exception exits the normal processing branch.
solution: Use version checks and reject stale synchronization updates. Use container-managed resource cleanup and add exception-path integration tests.

summary: Remote EJB invocation fails for certain clients after a rolling restart
issue_description: Remote EJB invocation fails for certain clients after a rolling restart. The behavior was reproduced in the staging environment using representative J2EE workload and application-server diagnostics.
root_cause: The remote interface changed incompatibly without coordinating the client artifact. The deployment sequence left stale runtime metadata on one node.
solution: Version the remote contract and deploy compatible client/server interfaces. Clear runtime metadata, restart the affected subsystem, and add post-deployment smoke tests.

summary: File processing reports success despite rejected records during peak concurrency
issue_description: File processing reports success despite rejected records during peak concurrency. The behavior was reproduced in the qa environment using representative J2EE workload and application-server diagnostics.
root_cause: The batch status is set before all record-level outcomes are committed. A container resource limit was lower than the measured production concurrency.

summary: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion under high load [Subsystem-2]
issue_description: HTTP 500 errors occurring across checkout workflows. Logs indicate 'Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms'.
root_cause: Connections were leaked in legacy DAO classes where PreparedStatement and ResultSet objects were not closed in finally blocks under exception scenarios.
solution: Refactored legacy JDBC DAO code to use Java try-with-resources blocks ensuring deterministic connection cleanup. Increased pool max-size to 50.
business_impact: Checkout failures affecting ~15% of active users during flash sale.

summary: OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space during bulk report generation [Subsystem-3]
issue_description: Exporting monthly reconciliation reports with >100k rows causes heap exhaustion and crashes the app server node.
root_cause: Hibernate list() method fetches the entire ResultSet into JVM heap memory at once without applying pagination or object streaming.
solution: Implemented JPA StatelessSession with ScrollableResults and dynamic batch fetching to stream data chunks directly to CSV output.
business_impact: Finance team unable to generate end-of-month financial settlement reports.

summary: High CPU utilization and thread deadlock during peak traffic [Subsystem-4]
issue_description: Application server CPU spiking to 100% with worker threads stuck in BLOCKED state during morning rush hours.
root_cause: Synchronized block on a shared singleton bean in legacy audit logger created severe contention across 200 HTTP worker threads.
solution: Replaced manual synchronized block with ConcurrentHashMap and asynchronous non-blocking logging using Log4j2 AsyncAppender.
business_impact: Mobile banking login delayed or timing out for 40 minutes.

summary: Payment gateway client thread pool starvation on upstream latency [Subsystem-5]
issue_description: Payment requests hanging indefinitely leading to total exhaustion of Tomcat worker threads.
root_cause: Default socket timeout on Apache HttpClient was unset (infinite), causing threads to wait indefinitely when third-party API stalled.
solution: Configured ConnectTimeout (1000ms) and SocketTimeout (3000ms) alongside Resilience4j Circuit Breaker and fallback handling.
business_impact: E-commerce platform unable to accept credit card payments globally.

summary: HTTP Session state corruption across clustered JBoss nodes [Subsystem-1]
issue_description: Users intermittently losing session data or seeing authorization errors after load balancer redirects traffic between nodes.
root_cause: Non-serializable object stored inside HttpSession triggering Java Serialization failure during Redis session replication.
solution: Implemented java.io.Serializable on custom DTO classes and added transient modifiers to non-essential cached fields.
business_impact: Users forced to re-authenticate repeatedly during browsing.

summary: ActiveMQ queue consumer stuck due to unhandled Poison Pill message [Subsystem-2]
issue_description: Notification queue depth escalating continuously. Messages not consuming despite active consumer threads.
root_cause: Uncaught ClassCastException during JMS ObjectMessage payload deserialization causing continuous redelivery loops without acknowledgment.
solution: Configured ActiveMQ Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) with maxRedelivery attempt threshold of 3 and custom MessageListener exception handler.
business_impact: SMS and Email notifications delayed by over 3 hours.

summary: Metaspace OutOfMemoryError after dynamic hot deployments [Subsystem-3]
issue_description: Tomcat server crashes with java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace after multiple web app redeployments.
root_cause: ThreadLocal variables in custom logging context were not removed on web application shutdown, pinning WebappClassLoader in memory.
solution: Added ServletContextListener to explicitly invoke ThreadLocal.remove() and unregister JDBC drivers on contextDestroyed.
business_impact: Staging/UAT environment frequent crashes during continuous deployment cycles.

summary: XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability in SOAP endpoint [Subsystem-4]
issue_description: Security penetration testing identified XXE vulnerability in parsing incoming XML SOAP requests.
root_cause: SAXParserFactory instance used for parsing XML payloads was initialized without disabling external DTD evaluation.
solution: Configured XMLInputFactory and DocumentBuilderFactory with FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING and set disallow-doctype-decl to true.
business_impact: Potential security compliance violation (PCI-DSS / OWASP Top 10).

summary: N+1 SELECT query performance degradation on catalog fetching [Subsystem-5]
issue_description: Fetching product catalog list executes over 1,200 separate SQL SELECT queries for child category items.
root_cause: Lazy fetch type defined on @OneToMany relation without explicit JOIN FETCH or EntityGraph specification in JPQL query.
solution: Refactored DAO query to use explicit JOIN FETCH and configured @BatchSize(size = 25) on child collections.
business_impact: Product catalog loading taking 8.5 seconds instead of target < 500ms.

summary: CORS preflight request failure for secondary domain origins [Subsystem-1]
issue_description: Browser blocking REST callouts from new partner domain with 'Response to preflight request doesn't pass access control check'.
root_cause: CorsConfigurationBean allowed domain list was hardcoded and missing new sub-domain origins.
solution: Externalized CORS allowed-origins setting into application.yml dynamic property list backed by Spring Cloud Config.
business_impact: Partner portal users unable to access account summary dashboard.

summary: Spring @Transactional rollback ignored on checked Exception [Subsystem-2]
issue_description: Database updates commit successfully even when custom OrderProcessingException is thrown during checkout workflow.
root_cause: Spring declarative transaction management defaults to rolling back only on Unchecked (RuntimeException) exceptions.
solution: Annotated service methods with @Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class) to ensure all checked exceptions trigger rollback.
business_impact: Inventory counts deducted without corresponding order creation.

summary: Spring Scheduled batch job executing concurrently across cluster [Subsystem-3]
issue_description: Nightly billing batch job runs simultaneously on all 4 application nodes causing duplicate invoice generation.
root_cause: @Scheduled annotation used without a distributed lock mechanism across clustered instance nodes.
solution: Integrated ShedLock library with JDBC database lock provider to guarantee single-node execution of scheduled tasks.
business_impact: Duplicate invoice emails sent to 120 customers.

summary: HTTP 400 Bad Request on large JSON payload submission [Subsystem-4]
issue_description: Users unable to upload documents with base64 strings larger than 2MB; server returns immediate HTTP 400.
root_cause: Tomcat default maxPostSize parameter set to 2097152 bytes (2MB), rejecting larger request bodies.
solution: Configured maxPostSize in Tomcat server.xml / application.properties to 10485760 bytes (10MB).
business_impact: Users unable to attach PDF contracts > 2MB.

summary: Missing Correlation ID in async executor log statements [Subsystem-5]
issue_description: Traceability lost in Kibana when log events transition from HTTP request threads to @Async background executor threads.
root_cause: Logback Mapped Diagnostic Context (MDC) context map is bound to ThreadLocal and not transferred to pool worker threads.
solution: Implemented custom TaskDecorator to copy parent thread MDC context to child task execution threads.
business_impact: Increased mean time to resolution (MTTR) during log tracing.

summary: Garbled characters in exported PDF invoices for EU locales [Subsystem-1]
issue_description: Special UTF-8 characters (e.g., German umlauts ä, ö, ü) render as question marks in output PDF documents.
root_cause: ServletOutputStream was utilizing default OS platform encoding (ISO-8859-1) instead of UTF-8 explicit encoding.
solution: Set response.setCharacterEncoding('UTF-8') and loaded explicit TrueType UTF-8 font into Apache PDFBox instance.
business_impact: Minor formatting issue in German customer invoices.

issue_description: Automated build pipeline blocked due to minor SonarQube rule violations regarding code cleanliness.
root_cause: Accumulated unused import statements and deprecated utility method calls following feature refactoring.
solution: Executed automatic IDE code cleanup, removed unused imports, and updated SonarQube quality gate thresholds for non-critical modules.

business_impact: Partner portal users unable to access account summary dashboard.

summary: Spring @Transactional rollback ignored on checked Exception [Subsystem-4]
issue_description: Database updates commit successfully even when custom OrderProcessingException is thrown during checkout workflow.

business_impact: Inventory counts deducted without corresponding order creation.

summary: Spring Scheduled batch job executing concurrently across cluster [Subsystem-5]
issue_description: Nightly billing batch job runs simultaneously on all 4 application nodes causing duplicate invoice generation.
root_cause: @Scheduled annotation used without a distributed lock mechanism across clustered instance nodes.
solution: Integrated ShedLock library with JDBC database lock provider to guarantee single-node execution of scheduled tasks.
business_impact: Duplicate invoice emails sent to 120 customers.

summary: HTTP 400 Bad Request on large JSON payload submission [Subsystem-1]
issue_description: Users unable to upload documents with base64 strings larger than 2MB; server returns immediate HTTP 400.
root_cause: Tomcat default maxPostSize parameter set to 2097152 bytes (2MB), rejecting larger request bodies.
solution: Configured maxPostSize in Tomcat server.xml / application.properties to 10485760 bytes (10MB).
business_impact: Users unable to attach PDF contracts > 2MB.

summary: Missing Correlation ID in async executor log statements [Subsystem-2]
issue_description: Traceability lost in Kibana when log events transition from HTTP request threads to @Async background executor threads.
root_cause: Logback Mapped Diagnostic Context (MDC) context map is bound to ThreadLocal and not transferred to pool worker threads.
solution: Implemented custom TaskDecorator to copy parent thread MDC context to child task execution threads.
business_impact: Increased mean time to resolution (MTTR) during log tracing.

summary: Garbled characters in exported PDF invoices for EU locales [Subsystem-3]
issue_description: Special UTF-8 characters (e.g., German umlauts ä, ö, ü) render as question marks in output PDF documents.
root_cause: ServletOutputStream was utilizing default OS platform encoding (ISO-8859-1) instead of UTF-8 explicit encoding.
solution: Set response.setCharacterEncoding('UTF-8') and loaded explicit TrueType UTF-8 font into Apache PDFBox instance.
business_impact: Minor formatting issue in German customer invoices.

summary: SonarQube quality gate failure due to unused imports and dead code [Subsystem-4]
issue_description: Automated build pipeline blocked due to minor SonarQube rule violations regarding code cleanliness.
root_cause: Accumulated unused import statements and deprecated utility method calls following feature refactoring.
solution: Executed automatic IDE code cleanup, removed unused imports, and updated SonarQube quality gate thresholds for non-critical modules.

summary: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion under high load [Subsystem-5]
issue_description: HTTP 500 errors occurring across checkout workflows. Logs indicate 'Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms'.
root_cause: Connections were leaked in legacy DAO classes where PreparedStatement and ResultSet objects were not closed in finally blocks under exception scenarios.
solution: Refactored legacy JDBC DAO code to use Java try-with-resources blocks ensuring deterministic connection cleanup. Increased pool max-size to 50.
business_impact: Checkout failures affecting ~15% of active users during flash sale.

summary: OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space during bulk report generation [Subsystem-1]
issue_description: Exporting monthly reconciliation reports with >100k rows causes heap exhaustion and crashes the app server node.
root_cause: Hibernate list() method fetches the entire ResultSet into JVM heap memory at once without applying pagination or object streaming.
solution: Implemented JPA StatelessSession with ScrollableResults and dynamic batch fetching to stream data chunks directly to CSV output.
business_impact: Finance team unable to generate end-of-month financial settlement reports.

summary: High CPU utilization and thread deadlock during peak traffic [Subsystem-2]
issue_description: Application server CPU spiking to 100% with worker threads stuck in BLOCKED state during morning rush hours.
root_cause: Synchronized block on a shared singleton bean in legacy audit logger created severe contention across 200 HTTP worker threads.
solution: Replaced manual synchronized block with ConcurrentHashMap and asynchronous non-blocking logging using Log4j2 AsyncAppender.
business_impact: Mobile banking login delayed or timing out for 40 minutes.

summary: Payment gateway client thread pool starvation on upstream latency [Subsystem-3]
issue_description: Payment requests hanging indefinitely leading to total exhaustion of Tomcat worker threads.
root_cause: Default socket timeout on Apache HttpClient was unset (infinite), causing threads to wait indefinitely when third-party API stalled.
solution: Configured ConnectTimeout (1000ms) and SocketTimeout (3000ms) alongside Resilience4j Circuit Breaker and fallback handling.
business_impact: E-commerce platform unable to accept credit card payments globally.

summary: HTTP Session state corruption across clustered JBoss nodes [Subsystem-4]
issue_description: Users intermittently losing session data or seeing authorization errors after load balancer redirects traffic between nodes.
root_cause: Non-serializable object stored inside HttpSession triggering Java Serialization failure during Redis session replication.
solution: Implemented java.io.Serializable on custom DTO classes and added transient modifiers to non-essential cached fields.
business_impact: Users forced to re-authenticate repeatedly during browsing.

summary: ActiveMQ queue consumer stuck due to unhandled Poison Pill message [Subsystem-5]
issue_description: Notification queue depth escalating continuously. Messages not consuming despite active consumer threads.
root_cause: Uncaught ClassCastException during JMS ObjectMessage payload deserialization causing continuous redelivery loops without acknowledgment.
solution: Configured ActiveMQ Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) with maxRedelivery attempt threshold of 3 and custom MessageListener exception handler.
business_impact: SMS and Email notifications delayed by over 3 hours.

summary: Metaspace OutOfMemoryError after dynamic hot deployments [Subsystem-1]
issue_description: Tomcat server crashes with java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace after multiple web app redeployments.
root_cause: ThreadLocal variables in custom logging context were not removed on web application shutdown, pinning WebappClassLoader in memory.
solution: Added ServletContextListener to explicitly invoke ThreadLocal.remove() and unregister JDBC drivers on contextDestroyed.
business_impact: Staging/UAT environment frequent crashes during continuous deployment cycles.

summary: XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability in SOAP endpoint [Subsystem-2]

business_impact: Potential security compliance violation (PCI-DSS / OWASP Top 10).
